introduction: I paint warm stories carried by the sky, the sea, and imagined beings.
biography: Mijung Choi paints the emotions found where imagination and reality meet.
Through quiet color and familiar beings, her work recalls landscapes held in memory.
statement: I paint warm stories carried by the sky, the sea, and imagined beings.
My work looks into emotions that linger between familiar landscapes and dreams.
quote: Painting is a record of the dreams I have encountered.
